regime: Strong dollar pulls gold back under $4,000 while tech rallies
takeaway: Gold slipped about 1.2% to near $3,983 as the dollar index rose to its highest since April 2025 and the yen weakened toward 160, while silver held flat, so the gold/silver ratio eased to about 77. Stocks went the other way, with the Nasdaq up 1.6% on a rebound in AI names, and the VIX fell to about 17.5. Treasury yields did not trade because of Veterans Day, so Thursday's bond session will show whether Fed hike bets keep building; gold's one-month slide (about −4%) and Brent above $90 keep those pattern checks in view.
